comparison.objective: Transport an opaque collar along a curved protected guide while maintaining clearance under changing occlusion; candidate commissions and dynamically tests an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Guide-threaded transport and view-dependent collision avoidance versus recessed hex engagement, captive-screw loosening, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and guarded test actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Collar must remain threaded, avoid prohibited contact, reach its support, be released, and remain still; exact numeric rubric is not included in the available record body. Candidate instead requires two force-, travel-, rebound-, drift-, and hard-stop-safe impact cycles.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is occluded constrained transport, not adjustment locking followed by measured dynamic commissioning.
